passages.text: Popeye the Sailor is credited with the catchphrase I'll gladly pay you Tuesday for a hamburger today. In the cartoons, the sailor makes the offer to a vendor who hesitates to give him food on credit, and the phrase has since been quoted widely by comedians and writers. Cultural histories of American animation attribute the line to Popeye, and it appears in many compilations of the best-known sayings from the golden age of cartoons.

question: when was the dome of the rock completed

passages.text: Encyclopedia entries on Islamic architecture consistently date the Dome of the Rock's completion to 705 CE. The shrine has an inner circle of columns and an outer octagonal arcade, creating a pattern that encourages circumambulation. Inscriptions in Kufic script wrap around the interior and proclaim religious messages. The building's early completion made it the oldest major monument of Islamic architecture, and its date is widely cited by art historians as a reference point.
